description:
HushGram v0.0.6 targets Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 (com.instagram.android) with 75 patches, 27 more than the last release. New ones include Lock your messages, Download voice messages, Save profile picture, Show a post's exact time, Ask before a like, Hide comments, Data saver and Full resolution photos.

Read Before you sign in in the README first. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do. Sign in with a spare account if you can, and don't clear the app's data afterward.

Validation: 2607 runtime tests passed locally. All 1053 patch tests passed too. All 75 patches applied to Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 450.0.0.50.77, version code 385611438. APKMirror lists another build under the same label, so check the number. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
